_comment: One full open Checkout Mandate, serialised end to end and pinned byte for
byte. Built from #12's own demo scenario: interpret.Demo()'s constraints
for "buy a flight to Palma when it drops below $200, this summer" (route
BEG-PMI, a cap of USD 20000 in minor units, the booking window), endorsing
the fixed agent key open_test.go's agentJWK returns, issued and expiring
at fixed instants so nothing here depends on a clock.
Reproducing it needs three things pinned together: the salts (newSalts,
already built for this), and the signer (hmacAuthzKey, a fixed HMAC-SHA256
key standing in for the ECDSA key issuance actually uses, since ECDSA's
own randomness would make a signed vector unreproducible regardless of
how the salts were drawn — see that type's comment in golden_test.go).
Everything else — claim order, _sd digest sorting, Disclosure encoding —
is this package's own deterministic output, which is the fact this vector
value it produced, and confirming that same value in a second, separate
`go test` process before this file was committed.
